margin.$description:
Distance from the viewport edge to the content area. 
Controls the breathing room between UI and screen edge. 
Scales across breakpoints — larger on desktop, tighter on mobile. 
Increase for a more premium, spacious feel. 
| ai-group:density | ai-impact:high

gutter.$description:
Space between columns in the layout grid. 
Controls visual separation between major content areas. 
Consistent across all content inside the grid. 
Increase to create more distinct column separation. 
| ai-group:density | ai-impact:medium

columns.$description:
Number of columns in the layout grid. 
Defines the structural skeleton of every screen. 
Typically 12 on desktop, 8 on tablet, 4 on mobile. 
Changing this affects how components snap to the grid. 
| ai-group:structure | ai-impact:high

width.$description:
The active working area width for app interfaces. 
Used in dashboard and tool layouts where content 
needs a defined working zone. 
| ai-group:structure | ai-impact:medium

min-width.$description:
Minimum width before the workspace starts to break. 
Below this value horizontal scrolling begins. 
Do not set lower than the smallest supported viewport. 
| ai-group:structure | ai-impact:low

max-width.$description:
Maximum width the workspace expands to on large screens. 
Prevents content from becoming too wide on ultra-wide displays. 
| ai-group:structure | ai-impact:medium

min-width.$description:
Minimum supported content width. 
Below this the layout is not guaranteed to work correctly. 
| ai-group:structure | ai-impact:low

max-width.$description:
Maximum width for reading and content-focused layouts. 
Used for article pages, forms, onboarding flows. 
Keeps line lengths comfortable for reading. 
Narrower than workspace — used when focus matters more than space. 
| ai-group:structure | ai-impact:medium
